store.studioCreditEmpty: You don't have a studio yet. Once you create a studio on Creator Island, you can convert Z-coin into AI credit shared by the team. AI actions on your personal island deduct Z-coin directly, no top-up needed.

store.faqPayA: Completely free. All chapters, lessons, AI tutors, and the Playground cost nothing — no hidden subscriptions or per-chapter purchases.
store.faqSignupQ: Do I need to sign up?
store.faqSignupA: Most content is viewable directly. Signing up lets you save progress, take notes, chat with AI tutors, and join leaderboards — and sign-up is also free.
store.faqLimitQ: Is there a limit on AI chats?
store.faqLimitA: No daily cap for everyday learning. The system keeps overall usage protection to prevent abuse, which normal use won't hit.
store.faqUpdateA: Yes. Chapters and lessons are added and revised every month; content already live will never later become paid.
store.faqWhyA: The site owner wants more people to learn coding and AI without barriers. If you enjoy it and share it with friends, that's the best reward.

home.trapSubtitle: Five trap bosses — beat them to truly level up!
home.trap1Symptom: The question is too vague, so the AI can’t tell what you want — of course the answer’s off!
home.trap1Solve: Give the AI clear context, needs, constraints and the output format you expect!
home.trap2Symptom: Blindly copy-pasting others’ prompts and using them without understanding how they work!
home.trap2Solve: Understand the structure and logic first, then adjust to your needs!
home.trap3Symptom: Asking for too much at once — too complex for the AI to nail perfectly in one shot!
home.trap3Solve: Break the problem down, go step by step, and refine gradually!
home.trap4Symptom: Believing everything without thinking, easily misled by wrong info!
home.trap4Solve: Verify sources, cross-check, and keep your skepticism and judgment!
home.trap5Symptom: Copying content without understanding it, so you learn nothing!
home.trap5Solve: Understand first, then output it — make it your own knowledge!
